instruction.text: Welche Berufe passen zu den Interessen der Personen? Wähle aus.

atoms.a: “My favourite subject at school is music. I'm also the lead singer in the school band. I just love listening to music, singing and writing my own songs.”
atoms.sound: My favourite subject at school is music. I'm also the lead singer in the school band. I just love listening to music, singing and writing my own songs.

atoms.a: “I like English, French and Spanish lessons. I think that I'm good with languages. After school, I watch videos in these languages and learn more about the different cultures.”
atoms.sound: I like English, French and Spanish lessons. I think that I'm good with languages. After school, I watch videos in these languages and learn more about the different cultures.

atoms.a: “I enjoy art lessons and I'm a member of the photography club. After school, I draw and paint a lot.”
atoms.sound: I enjoy art lessons and I'm a member of the photography club. After school, I draw and paint a lot.

atoms.a: “I like to watch films and TV series. Because of this, I tried out the theatre club at my school and found out that I love to act in plays.”
atoms.sound: I like to watch films and series. Because of this, I tried out the theatre club at my school and found out that I love to act in plays.

atoms.a: “I tried out the cooking and baking club at my school. Ever since, I have been baking birthday cakes for my family and friends.”
atoms.sound: I tried out the cooking and baking club at my school. Ever since, I have been baking birthday cakes for my family and friends.

atoms.a: “My favourite subject at school is physics. I'm really interested in planets, so I joined the astronomy club. There, we build our own rockets.”
atoms.sound: My favourite subject at school is physics. I'm really interested in planets, so I joined the astronomy club. There, we build our own rockets.

atoms.a: “I'm good at biology. I want to learn more about how our bodies work.”
atoms.sound: I'm good at biology. I want to learn more about how our bodies work.

atoms.a: “I'm interested in humanities. After school, I often visit the Museum of Natural Science. I wish we had an archaeology club at school.”
atoms.sound: I'm interested in humanities. After school, I often visit the Museum of Natrual Science. I wish we had an archeology club at school.

atoms.a: “I love to teach my little sister to read and write. I also like to explain topics that I understood to my classmates.”
atoms.sound: I love to teach my little sister to read and write. I also like to explain topics that I understood to my classmates.

atoms.a: “I'm in the book club, because I really like reading. Last week, I started writing short stories.”
atoms.sound: I'm in the book club, because I really like reading. Last week, I started writing short stories.
